verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents Teams/workspace collaboration for sharing collections, requests, and environments (docs-20, gh-6, docs-4), but hands-on community feedback flags real limitations — offline mode only supports one workspace and self-hosted login isn't available in the desktop app (comm-2), and users request git-based sync that isn't offered (comm-9). missing for 10: independent corroboration of smooth real-time sync at scale, git-friendly storage sync, and resolution of the offline/self-host workspace limitations noted by users.
